standard: course-sentence-translation 技能 R1–R4；键取自对齐原串

entries.en: Ludwick Marishane, a young man from South Africa, was with his friends in Limpopo when they started talking about inventing something to put on your skin so you don’t have to take a bath.
entries.zh: 来自南非的年轻人卢德维克·马里沙内和朋友们在林波波时，聊起了要发明一种涂在皮肤上的东西，让人不用洗澡。

entries.en: Ludwick thought that this was a great idea.
entries.zh: 卢德维克觉得这是个好主意。

entries.en: He used his mobile to do some research on the internet, and he found some shocking facts.
entries.zh: 他用手机在网上查资料，发现了一些令人震惊的事实。

entries.en: Millions of people around the world haven’t got clean water.
entries.zh: 全世界有数百万人没有干净的水。

entries.en: This is a huge problem because dirty water can create terrible illnesses.
entries.zh: 这是个大问题，因为脏水会引发可怕的疾病。

entries.en: One of them is trachoma: thousands of people all over the world get trachoma every year.
entries.zh: 其中一种是沙眼：全世界每年有成千上万人患上沙眼。

entries.en: They wash their faces with dirty water, get an infection and sometimes become blind.
entries.zh: 他们用脏水洗脸，受到感染，有时会失明。

entries.en: To stop trachoma, people don’t have to take expensive medication.
entries.zh: 要防止沙眼，人们不必吃昂贵的药。

entries.en: They don’t have to take pills.
entries.zh: 他们不必吃药片。

entries.en: They don’t have to have injections.
entries.zh: 他们不必打针。

entries.en: They have to wash their faces with clean water.
entries.zh: 他们必须用干净的水洗脸。

entries.en: That’s it.
entries.zh: 就这么简单。

entries.en: Ludwick started thinking.
entries.zh: 卢德维克开始思考。

entries.en: He wanted to make something to help people in parts of the world where it’s difficult to find clean water.
entries.zh: 他想做出一种东西，帮助世界上那些难以找到干净水源的地方的人们。

entries.en: He did more research on his mobile, and he did more thinking.
entries.zh: 他用手机做了更多研究，也想得更多。

entries.en: Ludwick had a plan.
entries.zh: 卢德维克有了一个计划。

entries.en: He wanted to make a gel for people to put on their skin so they don’t have to take a bath.
entries.zh: 他想做一种凝胶，让人们涂在皮肤上，就不用洗澡了。

entries.en: He wrote the formula for the gel on his mobile phone.
entries.zh: 他把凝胶的配方写在手机上。

entries.en: When he was at university, he never stopped thinking about his invention.
entries.zh: 上大学时，他一刻也没有停止思考自己的发明。

entries.en: He started to talk to other people about it, and three years later the dream came true.
entries.zh: 他开始和别人谈论这个想法，三年后，梦想成真了。

entries.en: He made the gel and called it ‘DryBath’.
entries.zh: 他做出了这种凝胶，并把它命名为 DryBath。

entries.en: It looks like any other gel, but it isn’t.
entries.zh: 它看起来和普通凝胶没什么两样，但其实不一样。

entries.en: This gel saves lives!
entries.zh: 这种凝胶能救命！

entries.en: Ludwick Marishane is the winner of lots of prizes.
entries.zh: 卢德维克·马里沙内赢得了很多奖项。

entries.en: People call him ‘one of the brightest young men in the world’.
entries.zh: 人们称他为“世界上最聪明的年轻人之一”。

entries.en: He is very happy about his success.
entries.zh: 他为自己的成功感到非常高兴。

entries.en: DryBath is helping people to be healthy.
entries.zh: DryBath 正在帮助人们保持健康。

entries.en: And DryBath also helps to save water.
entries.zh: 而且 DryBath 还有助于节约用水。

entries.en: That’s important in many parts of the world where it’s difficult to find clean water.
entries.zh: 这在世界上很多难以找到干净水的地方非常重要。

entries.en: Now he wants to invent other things, and he wants to help other young people to become inventors, too.
entries.zh: 现在他想发明更多东西，也想帮助其他年轻人成为发明家。
